identification: Three handmade sandstock bricks with finger-drawn marks: 'EAD'-style letters, a possible broad arrow (only one reads as an arrow, and it looks more like an upward stroke/spike than a clear broad arrow), and a zigzag 'WMVM' mark. Likely Tasmanian colonial-era bricks, ex Alanvale, Newnham. Marks may be brickmaker/finger marks rather than Government broad arrows.

viewing_check: Check whether any brick has a clear Government broad arrow (pointing-down arrowhead, often inside a stamped frame) versus finger-drawn maker marks; look for a Hobart Town, Engineers Dept or other stamped or incised mark, and check the cracked brick. Confirm the 'ex Alanvale' provenance paperwork if any.
